title: feat(security)!: View All and Modify All stop opening fields; viewAllFields is the one every-field bit
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-alice"} -->
_Requested by **Alice** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01NoziMoftaSPmzgKNjJGePH?thread=cmsg_01NoziMoftaSPmzgKNjJGePHV51tYVEf6EoB92QzbNcTG5)_

Fixes #36055

Blocked-by: #37314

Draft. #37314 opens the 19 migration step (`step19`, `CONVERSIONS_BY_MAJOR[19]`, the `semantic:19` region). When it merges, this branch merges main and adds the rest (see "Still to come"). Until then `check-adr-0087-registration` is red on purpose: the changeset names the conversion id that the 19 entry will register.

## Maintainer quick read

- From 19.0.0, View All (`viewAllRecords`) and Modify All (`modifyAllRecords`) widen records only. They cast no field vote. `viewAllFields` is the only "every field" channel: read only, never edit, and a set's own `readable: false` row beats it.
- Error direction: an unconverted set sees fewer fields, never more. No hidden field opens.
- Stored permission sets (Studio-saved) take the new meaning on upgrade, no rewrite (ruling A, comment 7177446075). Source sets get `viewAllFields: true` from `os migrate meta --from 18 --write`.
- Beyond the card's premise: Modify All's cross-set EDIT re-open is lost too, because `viewAllFields` votes read only. That includes the built-in admin beside an app set's edit lock (it still reads every field). This is the ruled field-axis split (ruling 6912661484); the D3 entry will name it.

## What changes

- `@objectstack/core`: `superuserFieldVote` is replaced by `viewAllFieldsReadVote(sets, object, field)`. `buildEffectiveFieldPermissions` asks it. `holdsSuperuserBypass` is unchanged and answers the record bypass only.
- `@objectstack/plugin-security`: `getFieldPermissions` asks the same vote. Explain drops the "superseded by the Modify All Data field vote" branch (and `ConditionedFieldEntry.supersededBy`): a row-conditioned lock binds per row for every caller.
- `@objectstack/lint`: `security-superuser-field-mask-inert` is retired (constant, catalog text, explanation, export). `security-cross-set-field-reopen` reports only a hidden field another set's `viewAllFields` re-opens, in all 11 locales. The controlled-by-parent master-reference rule and the roll-up source-visibility rules no longer skip a mask beside Modify All.
- `@objectstack/scenarios`: persona-grant scoring no longer treats Modify All as overriding a field lock.
- `@objectstack/spec`: `viewAllRecords` / `modifyAllRecords` / `viewAllFields` descriptions state the new meaning (generated reference docs regenerated). The liveness ledger anchors `viewAllFields` at `#viewAllFieldsReadVote`.
- Showcase: `showcase_auditor` (four View All entries) and ops' `showcase_announcement` Modify All entry carry `viewAllFields: true`, migrated by hand.
- Docs: field-level-security, authorization, permissions-matrix and the showcase security tour describe the 19 meaning.

## Why

Card #36055, step 3 of the field-axis split (#34365, ruling of record 6912661484): View All / Modify All widen records, `viewAllFields` reads fields.

## Still to come (after #37314 merges)

- `packages/spec/src/conversions/entries/19/permission-view-all-fields-beside-record-bypass.ts`: adds `viewAllFields: true` to every `objects` entry (wildcard included) that carries `viewAllRecords` or `modifyAllRecords` without it. `retiredFromLoadPath: true`, registered in `CONVERSIONS_BY_MAJOR[19]` and `step19`.
- The 19 semantic upgrade-guide entry, with the one-step check and the lint pointer.
- Ruling A: the id refused at the artifact door (`DEFAULT_FLIPS_NOT_REPLAYED_HERE`, `packages/metadata-core/src/artifact-forward-conversion.ts`) and at stored-row reads (`packages/spec/src/conversions/stored.ts`), with tests.
- Dogfood battery on the final head.

- Green: `check:doc-security-posture`, `check:doc-formula-expressions`, `check:i18n-stale-fill`, `check-skills-token-ratchet`, `check:doc-anchors`, `check:doc-authoring`, `check-affected-docs`, `check:spec-docblock-symbol-anchors`, `check:issue-citations`, `check-empty-changeset`, `check:docs-spec-enumerations`, `check-changeset-no-major` (pre mode).

## ADR-0066 D2 ⑧ end-state note (text for the weekly ADR card #37245)

> **Note (19.0.0): View All and Modify All cast no field vote (#36055, step 3 of the field-axis split #34365, ruling of record 6912661484).** A set's `viewAllRecords` or `modifyAllRecords` on an object widens which records it reaches and casts no vote in either field merge. The one object-wide field vote is `viewAllFields`: `readable: true` on every field of the object, never `editable: true`, and a set's own explicit `readable: false` row on a field beats its own bit (the note of 2026-11-15, now carried by `viewAllFields` alone). Both merges ask one function, `packages/core/src/security/effective-object-permissions.ts#viewAllFieldsReadVote`. Consequences: a set's own field rows bind beside its own View All or Modify All; another set's View All or Modify All re-opens no hidden or locked field; nothing re-opens a field edit lock across sets (the built-in admin sets read every field through their `'*'` `viewAllFields` and no longer edit a field another held set locks). The ADR-0087 conversion `permission-view-all-fields-beside-record-bypass` adds `viewAllFields: true` beside the bits in source; it is a default flip, refused by id at the artifact door and at stored-row reads, so stored sets take this meaning on upgrade (ruling A on #36055). `security-superuser-field-mask-inert` is retired; `security-cross-set-field-reopen` reports the `viewAllFields` re-open only.

## Follow-ups to file
